mission: Eliminate UI defects across Schedule & Appointments cluster: fix search icon overlap on placeholders, eradicate naked text rows, integrate canonical DENTE segmented bars and filter chips, and verify live pixel proof.
invariants_enforced: Mandate 8zf: Search Input Invariant & Segmented Controls Doctrine
Frontend Rules §§ 12-13: padding-left: 38px !important, left: 12px, pointer-events: none, .dente-segmented-bar, .dente-filter-chips
Designer Visual Inquisition Bible §§ 7-8: Single-height 32px controls, 1-row desktop toolbar, 44x44px touch targets on mobile
Mandate 8e: Doctor autonomy, zero disabled primary buttons, 1-click presets

apps/web/src/styles/components.css.changes: Updated .dente-search-input padding-left to 38px !important (Mandate 8zf / Frontend § 12) and icon left offset to 12px.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/Prevent.changes: Replaced naked category tabs and inline hex styles with .dente-filter-chips and .dente-filter-chip; replaced custom search input with .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/Tomorro.changes: Replaced custom channel buttons with .dente-segmented-bar and .dente-segmented-item; replaced custom search input with .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/DoctorF.changes: Removed inline hex styles; converted quick range, doctor, and chair buttons to .dente-filter-chips and .dente-filter-chip; converted duration presets and time-of-day filters to .dente-segmented-bar and .dente-segmented-item.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/Waitlis.changes: Replaced search input with .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear; converted urgency filter pills to .dente-filter-chips and .dente-filter-chip.
Replaced sub-tabs with .dente-segmented-bar and .dente-segmented-item; converted search input to .dente-search-wrap; converted priority filter pills to .dente-filter-chips and .dente-filter-chip.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/Appoint.changes: Upgraded patient search input to .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear while strictly preserving data-testid='appointment-patient-search-input'.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/QuickBo.changes: Upgraded patient typeahead search input to .dente-search-wrap, .dente-search-icon, .dente-search-input, and .dente-search-clear while preserving keyboard navigation and focus management.

Converted expo26-segmented-status header to .dente-segmented-bar with .dente-segmented-item; converted duration presets, quick status buttons, and common reasons to .dente-filter-chips and .dente-filter-chip.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/Schedul.changes: Harmonized StomX 3-stage day queue tabs with .dente-segmented-bar and .dente-segmented-item; converted all filter chips (All, My Chair, Doctors, Chairs, + Chair) to .dente-filter-chips and .dente-filter-chip; harmonized view mode switcher with .dente-segmented-bar and .dente-segmented-item; added .primary-button and .secondary-button classes.

apps/web/src/components/schedule/ChairSc.changes: Converted 3-state schedule density mode switcher to .dente-segmented-bar and .dente-segmented-item; applied .secondary-button to shifts menu trigger; converted add chair button to .dente-filter-chip.
